lead: When something is due. Before the deadline the time left in plain text ("in 5 hours"); after it a red [Tag](/tag) with "Overdue" and how long ago. A `done` item has nothing due (a dash) and a `paused` clock says so in a grey tag. It counts again every minute, so a page that stays open turns red on time. The time is a [Relative Time](/relative-time).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: A ticket, a task, an invoice: anything with a deadline.

states.title: The four states
states.description: Coming up, overdue, paused (waiting for the customer) and done.

labels.title: Texts and units
labels.description: `labels` replaces the texts for another language; `hoursUntil` is how long the time counts in hours before it counts in days (48 by default).

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: DueTag has no slot of its own: it is a [Tag](/tag) or plain text, styled by their stylesheets.
